Subject: Your land dispute matter - O.S. No. 606/2025

Dear Mr. Kapoor,

Thank you for meeting us on 9 July 2025 about your dispute with Smita Subramanian. As we understand it, construction has started on the disputed plot.

Our advice is to seek a temporary injunction to stop construction on the plot. Please collect photographs of the construction and the land records and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
